description:
**Req ID:** 369165
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Helpdesk Associate \- ITIL to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

**"General Duties and Responsibilities:**  

**In these roles, you will be responsible for:**  

Provide exceptional IT Service Desk support, guidance, and training to end\-users for various IT devices, applications, or processes.
  
Record, Update, and Escalate Support issues to the next level promptly.
  
Support all IT onboarding activities for end\-users
  
Work with our internal IT Teams on system testing, integration, and maintenance.

Willing to learn grow in other IT Business areas
  
  

**Requirements for this role include:**  

Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
  
Exceptional customer service skills.
  
Great Team player
  
24/7 rotational shifts and week offs and Work from Office mandatory
  
Excellent communication skills, comfortable working with various stakeholders
  
Strong troubleshooting skills, bug\-finding, and resolution
  
Ability to work independently within a diverse global team
  
IT software and hardware troubleshooting knowledge and skills (Win 10, macOS, iOS, Android, Google Suite and Microsoft Environment)"
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Technical Support Executive to assist customers in resolving technical issues related to our products/services. The ideal candidate will have strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to customer queries via phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems in a timely and accurate manner
* Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues related to software, hardware, or network problems
* Guide customers through step\-by\-step solutions, ensuring clear and simple communication
* Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate internal teams (Level 2/3 support, engineering, etc.)
* Log and track all customer interactions and technical issues in the CRM/ticketing tool
* Maintain and update the knowledge base with common issues, solutions, and FAQs
* Follow up with customers to ensure their issues are fully resolved
* Identify recurring issues and provide feedback to product/engineering teams for improvement
* Meet or exceed defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements) for response and resolution time
* Provide remote assistance using tools like TeamViewer, AnyDesk, or similar, where applicable
* Educate customers on product features and best practices to prevent future issues
* Stay updated on product releases, updates, and known issues

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in IT, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 1–3 years of experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or customer service role
* Strong understanding of operating systems (Windows/macOS/Linux), networking basics, and common software applications
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users
* Familiarity with ticketing systems (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira Service Desk, etc.)
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment
* Customer\-first mindset with patience and empathy

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: Helpdesk Engineer
description:
Join a team which leverages media, legal and data-driven expertise to strengthen independent journalism, enable access to the law and promote responsible business.
 We are the corporate foundation of Thomson Reuters, one of the world s leading content and technology companies. A registered charity in the UK and the USA, our expertise is embedded across the globe.
 The Thomson Reuters Foundation s Product Technology team supports the digital tools, platforms and services that enable our staff to deliver work across multiple regions and programmes. We are seeking a Helpdesk Engineer to provide first-line technology support to colleagues across the Foundation, helping staff resolve day-to-day IT issues quickly, clearly and professionally.
 This is an entry-level technology support role suited to someone with strong troubleshooting instincts, good communication skills and a practical interest in helping non-technical users. The successful candidate will support common issues across laptops, accounts, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, Wi-Fi, VPN, printers and business applications, while learning from more experienced colleagues across the Product Technology team.
 Key Responsibilities: Provide first-line technical support to TRF staff, responding to support requests through the team s ticketing system and other approved support channels. Triage, investigate and resolve common IT issues, including account access, password and MFA problems, laptop and peripheral issues, Wi-Fi, VPN, printers, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and collaboration tools. Escalate more complex incidents or service requests to appropriate colleagues or Thomson Reuters support teams, providing clear notes, relevant context and accurate troubleshooting steps already taken. Support onboarding and offboarding activities, helping ensure that new joiners and leavers have the right equipment, access and guidance at the right time. Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, known issues and follow-up actions in the ticketing system. Create and update simple user-facing guidance, knowledge articles and internal support notes so that common issues can be resolved consistently. Communicate clearly and patiently with colleagues, translating technical issues into plain language and helping users understand next steps. Follow agreed information security, data protection and access management processes, escalating risks or unusual activity where appropriate. Contribute to continuous improvement of the helpdesk function by identifying recurring issues, process gaps and opportunities to improve staff experience. Work Mode: Hybrid (2-3 days work from office is mandatory every week). Shift Timing: 12pm IST to 9pm IST. Required Qualifications : Bachelors or Masters degree is required. At least 1-3 years of relevant experience. Basic computer troubleshooting skills and the ability to work through problems logically. Experience using and supporting Windows and/or macOS devices. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace, including tools such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Gmail, Google Drive and Google Meet. Some familiarity with IT support, service desk or ticketing systems, and a willingness to follow structured incident and request management processes. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users. Good attention to detail, including the ability to keep accurate notes and follow agreed processes. A basic understanding of common workplace technology issues, including passwords, MFA, Wi-Fi, VPN, printing, software installation and account access. A customer-focused approach, with patience, professionalism and a willingness to help colleagues resolve issues. A willingness to learn, ask questions and develop technical skills through hands-on support work and guidance from more experienced colleagues. Relevant work experience, internship experience, customer support experience or demonstrable practical technical experience. Formal education in IT or computer science is welcome but not essential. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Jira Service Management, ServiceNow or another ticketing platform. Basic experience with Active Directory, Azure Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, or identity and access management concepts. Experience supporting enterprise collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Zoom, Google Workspace or similar platforms. Prior helpdesk, IT support, desktop support, internship or customer support experience in a medium-sized or large organisation. Basic familiarity with Power Platform tools, such as Power Automate or Power Apps. Basic familiarity with Linux or command-line tools. Awareness of cyber security good practice, including phishing, least-privilege access, secure password practices and safe handling of organisational data. Experience writing simple how-to guides, FAQs or knowledge base articles for end users. #LI-GS2 What s in it For You Global Perspective and Impact: Interested in working for a dynamic global organization with a focus on social impact With hubs all over the world from Bangkok to Madrid to Rio de Janeiro, join a truly international team with a shared goal of helping to build societies around the world that are free, fair, and informed. Unique Approach: Our expertise in media and the law is world class. We combine the power of both to address the critical issues faced by humanity. Our Relevance: With a focus on advancing media freedom, fostering more inclusive economies and promoting human rights, our work has never been more needed than right now. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer competitive salary packages and market-leading benefits. Learning Development: We are dedicated to the continual professional development of our employees and offer access to both in-house and external training opportunities. About Thomson Reuters Foundation The Thomson Reuters Foundation is the corporate foundation of Thomson Reuters, the global news and information services company. As an independent charity, registered in the UK and USA, we leverage our media, legal and data driven expertise to strengthen independent journalism, enable access to the law and promote responsible business. Through news, media development, free legal assistance and data intelligence, we aim to build free, fair and informed societies. About Thomson Reuters We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here . Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here . More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Senior IT Administrator
description:
Bangalore \| 3\+ Years Experience \| Full\-time \|
 **6 Days Working**
 If you’re the person everyone calls when IT stops working, this one’s for you.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior IT Administrator who can take ownership of our IT infrastructure, keep systems running smoothly, and make sure our hardware, software, networks, and data are handled properly.
   

  

 This role is not just about fixing laptops when something breaks.
   

  

 It’s about keeping the entire IT environment secure, organised, reliable, and running without unnecessary downtime.
   

  

 You’ll be working with systems and information that require discretion, confidentiality, and responsible handling of sensitive data.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage and maintain the organisation’s IT infrastructure, systems, hardware and software.
* Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, network equipment and other IT assets.
* Manage software installations, updates, licences, access and user permissions.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network and system\-related issues.
* Monitor system performance and ensure IT infrastructure remains reliable and available.
* Maintain proper records of IT assets, software licences, systems and configurations.
* Implement and maintain data security, backups and access\-control practices.
* Ensure sensitive company information and data is handled with strict confidentiality.
* Support employees with day\-to\-day IT requirements and resolve issues efficiently.
* Identify potential IT risks and recommend practical improvements.
* Ensure systems are updated, secure and compliant with internal IT policies.
* Support onboarding and offboarding by setting up or disabling devices, accounts and access.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3\+ years in IT/System Administration.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* Strong hardware \+ software knowledge.
* Good understanding of networks, operating systems and IT infrastructure.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with user access, permissions and IT security.
* Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential company data.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise issues and take ownership.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Reliable, discreet and proactive.


**What Will Set You Apart**
* 
+ Experience managing IT infrastructure for a growing organisation.
+ Knowledge of cloud\-based systems and SaaS applications.
+ Experience with endpoint security, antivirus/EDR and device management.
+ Understanding of cybersecurity best practices.
+ Experience managing backups and disaster\-recovery processes.
+ Familiarity with access management and security policies.
+ Ability to proactively identify IT issues before they become bigger problems.


**What This Role Is NOT**
* 
+ This isn’t just a “fix the Wi\-Fi and reset the password” job. You’ll be responsible for the systems people rely on every day and the information they trust us to protect. That means technical knowledge, attention to detail, discretion and accountability are non\-negotiable.


**Why join us?**
* 
+ You’ll have real ownership over the organisation’s IT environment and the opportunity to build stronger, more secure and efficient systems as the organisation grows. You’ll work across hardware, software, infrastructure, security and employee IT support, giving you visibility across the entire organisation.


**How To Apply**
* 
+ Send your CV to contact@designboxed.com.
+ We’re particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong technical knowledge, problem\-solving ability, ownership and a responsible approach to handling company systems and sensitive data.

description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **System Administrator** to manage, configure, and continuously improve an enterprise platform based on customer and business requirements.

The role involves **user access management, system configuration, module administration, workflow automation, dashboards, issue management, and customer coordination**. You will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to implement approved requests, resolve system\-related issues, and ensure the platform operates efficiently.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience administering an **enterprise, work\-order management, facilities management, SaaS, or similar business platform**, along with strong communication, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and configuration skills.

Key Responsibilities

User Access Management

* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts based on approved requests.
* Manage user roles, permissions, and access levels.
* Maintain accurate access controls and system governance.
* Ensure access requests are completed accurately and within required timelines.

Customer Communication \& Issue Management

* Communicate system performance issues, service updates, and system changes to customers.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders during system\-related issues.
* Provide clear updates on issue status, resolution progress, and planned improvements.
* Track customer questions and requests through to completion.

Feature Requests \& System Improvements

* Review customer suggestions, enhancement requests, and system feedback.
* Work with internal stakeholders to assess the feasibility of requested changes.
* Implement approved configuration changes based on customer requirements.
* Communicate decisions, timelines, and progress to customers.
* Identify opportunities to improve system usability and operational efficiency.

Module Administration

Manage customer requests and configurations across various platform modules, including:

* Locations and Provider Assignments
* Asset Management
* Refrigerant Tracking
* Site Planning
* Inventory Management
* Supply Manager Administration
* Planned Maintenance

Process Configuration \& Optimization

* Update business hours and user/location\-level settings.
* Configure multi\-level invoice and proposal approval processes.
* Implement automated invoice approval workflows.
* Review existing workflows and identify opportunities for simplification and automation.
* Ensure configuration changes meet customer requirements and business processes.

Dashboard \& System Configuration

* Configure dashboards based on customer reporting and operational requirements.
* Manage issue\-list settings for accurate issue tracking and resolution.
* Maintain configuration consistency and data accuracy across the platform.
* Test configuration changes before implementation.
* Document important system and configuration changes.

Required Qualifications

* **4\+ years of experience** in System Administration, Platform Administration, Application Administration, SaaS Administration, or similar roles.
* Hands\-on experience administering an **enterprise, work\-order management, facilities management, or business operations platform**.
* Experience managing user accounts, roles, permissions, and system configurations.
* Strong understanding of system configuration and workflow management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management skills.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple customer requests and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with **Facilities Management (FM)** or **Work Order Management** platforms.
* Knowledge of **invoices, proposals, planned maintenance, assets, inventory, locations, and provider management**.
* Experience configuring **dashboards, workflows, approval processes, and automation**.
* Familiarity with **issue tracking, system testing, and configuration documentation**.
* Experience working with **SaaS or enterprise applications**.
* Exposure to customer support or technical/application support environments is an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of **system administration**, understand customer requirements, implement configurations accurately, troubleshoot system\-related issues, and proactively identify opportunities to improve platform processes and operational efficiency.

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 4\+ Years  
**Work Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per month

* How have you managed users, roles, permissions, and access provisioning?

* Which enterprise/SaaS, Facilities Management, Work Order Management, or business platform have you administered? What were your key responsibilities?
* Describe your experience with system configuration, workflows, approval processes, or automation.
